questions.question: A shopkeeper sold the following items to Arushi earning profit on it. How much total profit (in ₹) did he earn on the basis of the given data? Item Cost Price per unit ( ₹ ) Profit on cost(%) Mobile 20,000 10 Laptop 72,000 20 Mobile covers 300 12

Mobile 20,000 10

questions.solution:
Given:

The cost price per unit and profit percentage for each item:

Item Cost Price (₹) Profit Percentage (%)
Mobile 20,000 10%
Laptop 72,000 20%
Mobile Covers 300 12%

Formula used:

Profit = (Profit Percentage / 100) × Cost Price

Total Profit = Sum of profits for all items

Calculations:

Step 1: Calculate profit for each item:

Profit on Mobile = (10 / 100) × 20,000 = 2,000

Profit on Laptop = (20 / 100) × 72,000 = 14,400

Profit on Mobile Covers = (12 / 100) × 300 = 36

Step 2: Add up the profits:

Total Profit = 2,000 + 14,400 + 36 = 16,436

The total profit earned by the shopkeeper is ₹16,436.
